project.title: The greatest film competition in human history
project.goal: Find a picture of the future acceptable to most humans.
project.format: Films are at most two minutes and present an organization of human systems the creator believes would benefit most humans. Entry costs $1; the winner takes the pool minus operating costs. Anyone may join at any time, and submitted films appear in an open gallery.
project.ending: The competition ends when a special consensus clock built by Adi, Instinct, and Jev shows. The clock seeks broad, fair consensus under one-person-one-vote rules.

pool_source: Candidate options are ours; choice, probabilities, confidence, and noul values are Jev's.

whether_to_do_it.instructions: Given the actual project and its unresolved risks, what should we do?

criteria.do_it_now: commit to building and launching the full competition now
criteria.small_pilot_first: run a bounded small pilot first and use evidence to decide whether to scale
criteria.do_it_differently: keep the goal but materially redesign the mechanism before any pilot

future_most_humans_accept.instructions: Will it produce a picture of the future most humans accept?

regret_if_we_do_not.instructions: Will you regret it if we don't do it?

fair_to_humans.instructions: Is it fair to the humans it claims to represent?
